evidence.observedFact: The business requests a 20% deposit for online bookings and requires cancellations and rescheduling to be completed at least 24 hours before the appointment.
The active business website currently offers online booking and gift cards and lists current operating hours at its Mentor location.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate automated appointment recovery and rebooking follow-up around the salon's existing deposit and cancellation workflow.
Demonstrate a repeat-service reactivation workflow that complements online booking and gift-card activity.

recommendedEntryOffer: Booking Recovery + Client Reactivation Revenue Engine
notes: The deposit and cancellation requirements are observed facts. Reactivation is an opportunity hypothesis based on the active repeat-service booking model and gift-card offering, not proof of deficient retention or monetary loss.
